description: Search UK job listings — filter by keywords, location, distance, salary range (GBP), contract type (permanent/contract/temp), full/part time. Returns title, company, salary, applications count, direct link. UK largest job board (Reed.co.uk)

distance.description: Search radius in miles from location (default 10)

location.description: UK location — city, town, or postcode (e.g. "London", "Manchester", "SW1A 1AA")

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (must be divisible by limit)

name: jobs.reed.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search UK Jobs
